desc:
🏈 Dodge every tackle and score the touchdown!

🏃 Rush the ball to the end zone
💥 Get tackled and you join the defense
🏆 Be the last runner standing to win

⚡ Juke, dive and break away
🌀 Pick a move: Spin, Stiff Arm or Stop & Go
🏟️ 3 maps: night stadium, backyard and rooftop
🗳️ Vote for the next map
🎯 Learn the moves on the practice field
🎨 Unlock helmets, jerseys, footballs and celebrations
⭐ Level up and complete goals
📣 The crowd roars on every big tackle

👍 Like and favorite for updates!
